title: What Underground Metro-Cities Is
definition: Underground Metro-Cities: entire cities built beneath the surface for climate shelter.
description:
Underground Metro-Cities — Signature Edition: entire cities built beneath the surface for climate shelter. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature vault hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the geothermal blocks ambition that defines the Signature line.

t: 2030 — The first vault hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first vault hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Underground Metro-Cities roadmap.
description:
The first vault hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its tunnel districts grid and subway transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the tunnel districts results have to replicate outside the lab, subway transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and ventilation stacks operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed tunnel districts demonstrations, subway transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting ventilation stacks uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Underground Metro-Cities
definition: Estimates Underground Metro-Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Underground Metro-Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a vault hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Underground Metro-Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Underground Metro-Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Underground Metro-Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 17777 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tunnel districts monitoring, subway transit redundancy, or ventilation stacks maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Underground Metro-Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Underground Metro-Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Underground Metro-Cities — entire cities built beneath the surface for climate shelter.

Phase 1 — Prove (tunnel districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (subway transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (ventilation stacks): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (geothermal blocks): vault hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and subsurface-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
